affected_outputs: No protected R3 scorer spec or interval queue spec had been generated or run. Existing completed B0 witness units are unchanged.
correction: Protected scorer specs inherit the exact Python executable from the successfully completed corrected B0 witness spec; interval specs require an absolute tested interpreter, verify NumPy/SciPy import, resolve and hash the binary. R2 dependency unit IDs remain explicit --dep values and are never inferred.
issue: The R3 postfit spec builders previously used the builder process sys.executable. A builder launched by a base Python could produce a scorer spec lacking NumPy/SciPy.
